description: Antennes mobiles 2G/3G/4G - Orléans métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ARCEP. Ce jeu de données recense et localise les antennes mobiles des quatre opérateurs et la disponibilité des différentes technologies (2G, 3G, 4G) sur les sites d'Orléans métropole. Données issues de l'ARCEP, fédérées par Données enrichies par les coordonnées géographiques des IRIS dans lesquelles se trouvent les antennes. Coverage: ARCEP. The publisher named on the listing is ARCEP. Its keywords include arcep, telecommunication, inclusion-numerique, reseau-mobile. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2021-03-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
